_comment: Rules for scripts/phone_evidence.py (5.8). Each names a roadmap row (its title and URL) and the events in verification_events.jsonl that close it. A rule is written from the row's closing condition; where the condition also needs a judgement (how something looks), `needs` says so and the rule only proves the mechanism ran. Event names and fields are VerificationJournal.record calls in the app.

rules.row: Interactive Deep Think Live Activities (Stop keeps the written text)
rules.needs: During a Deep Think answer, lock the phone and tap Stop on the Lock Screen or Dynamic Island.

rules.row: Deep Think and Maximum show progress on the Lock Screen
rules.needs: Ask a Deep Think question and lock the phone until it finishes.

rules.row: Long answer outlives 30 s background grant
rules.needs: Ask a Deep Think question, leave the app at once, come back after it would have finished.

rules.row: Question-answering background task had the import's fixed name
rules.needs: Same as the long-answer check.

rules.row: iOS never started the import's background task
rules.needs: Start an import of a large PDF and leave the app for over a minute.

rules.row: iOS ended a background import during overview/tags calls
rules.needs: Import something, leave the app until it finishes, come back.

rules.row: Library built from all-zero vectors when embedding fails
rules.needs: Start an import and leave the app at once.

rules.row: Multi-file imports wait on each file's overview before the next file (5.8)
rules.needs: Add three or more files at once with the app open.

rules.row: Import cards stay on the Lock Screen and Watch after the app is opened (5.8)
rules.needs: Import something, leave the app until it ends, open the app again. Also look at the Watch: the card should be gone.

rules.row: App Store ratings: Apple's sheet only, asked once per version (5.8)
rules.needs: Ask a question in a library with your own documents; Apple's sheet should appear about 2 s after a Verified answer.

rules.row: Web Clipper / Share Extension
rules.needs: In Safari, share a page to OpenIntelligence, then open the app.

rules.row: Scan a page into a library from the Lock Screen
rules.needs: Add the Scan control to the Lock Screen, scan a page while locked, then unlock and open the app.

rules.row: Handoff: continue on the Mac what is open on the phone
rules.needs: Open a document on one device and take it from the Dock or app switcher on the other (log read on the receiving device).

rules.row: Siri and Spotlight can search inside OpenIntelligence
rules.needs: Say "Search OpenIntelligence for rent".

rules.row: Visual Intelligence returns matching documents
rules.needs: Point Visual Intelligence at a printed label that one of your documents names.

rules.row: A Focus filter chooses which libraries show
rules.needs: Add OpenIntelligence's filter to a Focus, pick a library, turn the Focus on and off.

rules.row: Actions that open a specific library, document or answer
rules.needs: Run Open Library and Open Document from Siri or Shortcuts.

rules.row: Siri can open a document or library by name
rules.needs: Say "Open <document name> in OpenIntelligence".

rules.row: Web links open the app, or the App Store
rules.needs: Tap a document's link in Notes or Messages.

rules.row: Every document, library and answer has its own link
rules.needs: Copy a document's link, paste it into Notes, tap it.

rules.row: Home Screen and Lock Screen Widgets
rules.needs: Place both widgets and tap each; Your Library should show your library's name and count.

rules.row: Ask and Add in Control Center, Lock Screen, Action button
rules.needs: Add the Ask and Add controls to Control Center and the Lock Screen, set one on the Action button, use each.

rules.row: Newer transcriber never compiled; recordings use older recognizer
rules.needs: Import a voice memo.

rules.row: Recording language read from two letters in file name
rules.needs: Import an English voice memo named like "Plumber visit_friday.m4a"; the transcript should be English.

rules.row: App records hangs, slow launches, terminations (MetricKit)
rules.needs: Nothing: use the app for a day; iOS delivers the report.

rules.row: Per-state metrics show what gets killed for memory
rules.needs: Nothing: needs a day of use and a termination iOS reports.

rules.row: A local crash report the person can send
rules.needs: Only after a real crash: the next launch offers the report.

rules.row: Deep Think and imports ease off when resources are short
rules.needs: Use the app in Low Power Mode or while the phone is hot; iOS decides when it asks.

rules.row: On PCC, Deep Think/Maximum steps went without evidence
rules.needs: In Deep Think, allow Private Cloud Compute for a long question.

rules.row: "Just Once" PCC consent carries to the next question
rules.needs: In Deep Think choose Just Once, then ask a second question that needs Private Cloud Compute.

rules.row: Action needing PCC consent moves to foreground and asks
rules.needs: Run a Deep Think shortcut with the app closed that needs Private Cloud Compute.

rules.row: Watched folders (5.8)
rules.needs: Library Settings, Watch a Folder, add a file to it, reopen the app.

rules.row: Deep Think and large imports from a shortcut past 30 s
rules.needs: Run an Ask shortcut in Deep Think with the app closed; it should finish.

rules.row: Answer cards in Siri have buttons
rules.needs: Ask Siri a question about your library, then tap Ask a Follow-Up and Think Deeper on the card.
